headline: SOUTHERN CROSS DRILLS 36.6m AT 6.5 g/t AuEq FROM 700m DEPTH; Two New Unmodelled Zones at Apollo East — 11 Rigs Running in Victoria
snippet: Southern Cross Gold Consolidated (TSX: SXGC / ASX: SX2) released June 10 results from seven drill holes at the Apollo and Apollo East prospects within the Sunday Creek Gold-Antimony Project in Victoria, highlighting drill hole SDDSC202 which returned 36.6 metres at 4.0 g/t Au and 1.0% Sb (6.5 g/t AuEq) from 700 metres depth, including peak assays up to 493 g/t Au and 29.1% Sb — and two previously unmodelled high-grade zones added to the Apollo East vein architecture. The shallowest Apollo East result to date, SDDSC217, extended the system ~97 metres toward surface with 0.1m at 55.8 g/t Au and 31.3% Sb from 324.9m; eleven rigs are operating on a 200,000-metre drill program running to Q1 2027. Antimony is a U.S.-designated critical mineral with no domestic primary production.

headline: ERO COPPER EXTENDS FURNAS SE ZONE 115m DOWN-DIP: 90m at 0.74% Cu Including 32m at 1.17% Cu in Brazil — PFS Advancing at 10-Rig Carajás Project
snippet: Ero Copper Corp. (TSX: ERO) released June 10 assay results from an additional 24,000 metres of drilling at the Furnas Copper-Gold Project in Brazil's Carajás Mineral Province, bringing total metres drilled to over 75,000 with ten rigs still operating and the deposit remaining open to depth and along strike. Step-out hole FURN-DD-00357 returned 90 metres grading 0.74% Cu, 0.5 g/t Au and 3.18 g/t Ag from 726 metres, extending the Southeast zone 115 metres down-dip; FURN-DD-00354 intersected 45 metres at 0.98% Cu including 20 metres at 1.78% Cu, pushing 80 metres beyond the current inferred resource boundary. Ero is advancing permitting, engineering, and environmental workstreams toward a Pre-Feasibility Study.

headline: CAMINO DRILLS 76.2m AT 0.88% Cu IN PERU: 16.25m Grading 2.67% Cu at IOCG Discovery — Japanese Major Nittetsu Holds 35% Stake at Costa de Cobre
snippet: Camino Minerals Corp. (TSXV: COR) announced June 10 Phase 2 drill results from Costa de Cobre, a district-scale iron-oxide-copper-gold (IOCG) discovery in Peru where Camino operates with a 65% interest alongside Japanese strategic partner Nittetsu Mining Co. Ltd. (35%). Five holes across approximately 400 metres of strike at the Adriana target all intersected copper mineralization, with the headline result returning 76.2 metres grading 0.88% Cu including 16.25 metres at 2.67% Cu and 6.82 g/t Ag from less than 260 metres depth — a near-surface, high-grade-core IOCG system timely given the pending U.S. Section 232 copper tariff decision due before mid-June.

headline: 34 HOLES AND GROWING: Galway Metals Hits 5.0 g/t Au Over 10.85m at Clarence Stream North Deposit in New Brunswick
snippet: Galway Metals Inc. (TSXV: GWM) announced June 10 assay results from 34 diamond drill holes at the North Deposit within the Clarence Stream high-grade gold project in New Brunswick, with a standout intercept of 5.0 g/t Au over 10.85 metres and continued gold intersections extending the Northern Extension beyond the current resource boundary. Clarence Stream hosts 12.4 Mt at 2.3 g/t Au indicated (922,000 oz) and 16.0 Mt at 2.6 g/t Au inferred (1.33 Moz) along a 65-kilometre-trend gold system; the 34-hole batch represents one of the largest single result packages in the project's drilling history.

headline: MEXICO SILVER DISTRICT GROWS: Mithril Drills 7.25m at 4.01 g/t Au, 225 g/t Ag at Copalquin — Updated Resource Estimate Due Late June
snippet: Mithril Silver and Gold Ltd. (TSXV: MSG / ASX: MTH) released June 10 results from five drill holes at the El Refugio western expansion and La Soledad south-east extension of the Copalquin polymetallic district in Durango State, Mexico. El Refugio's standout intercept returned 7.25 metres at 4.01 g/t Au and 225 g/t Ag including 0.5 metres at 15.25 g/t Au and 533 g/t Ag; La Soledad confirmed six subparallel mineralised structures outside the 2021 resource footprint. Mithril has completed 11,238 metres of a 25,000-metre 2026 campaign, with an updated mineral resource estimate due in late June.

headline: SIX NEW PORPHYRY TARGETS DEFINED: Alkane's Aerial Survey Opens Untested Corridor Alongside Boda-Kaiser Copper-Gold Complex in NSW
snippet: Alkane Resources Limited (ASX/TSX: ALK) announced June 10 a regional exploration update for the Boda-Kaiser area of its Northern Molong Porphyry Project in New South Wales, including the outcome of Mobile Magnetotellurics (MMT) flown north of the known deposits. The survey defined six high-priority porphyry-style targets — Driell Creek, Murga, Gollan North, and two newly named prospects One Tree and Old Station — all untested intrusive targets queued for the 2026-27 drill campaign; a diamond drill hole testing the inter-deposit zone between Kaiser and Boda intersected an intrusive-hydrothermal breccia with a magmatic root zone, suggesting district-scale structural connectivity between the two deposits.

headline: PITCHBLENDE, THEN 300m STEP-OUT: F4 Uranium and UraniumX Confirm Radioactive Deformation Zone at Athabasca Basin's Murphy Lake
snippet: F4 Uranium Corp. (TSXV: FFU) and UraniumX Discovery Corp. (CSE: STMN) announced June 9 that two step-out drillholes at Murphy Lake, Saskatchewan — drilled approximately 300 metres along strike from the program's first two holes — both intersected the same graphitic and sulphide-bearing deformation zone with anomalous radioactivity: ML26-017 returned 0.5 metres at 460 counts per second within a ~13-metre deformation zone; ML26-018 hit 350 cps up-dip of the previous hole. The lateral confirmation extends the footprint of a target where earlier hole ML26-015 had intersected visually identified pitchblende — the first 2026 hole to do so — making these step-outs the first evidence that the mineralized host structure has meaningful strike length.

headline: MONEY METALS: SPIKING CPI IS A GOLD BUY SIGNAL — Inflation Could Compress Real Yields Even If the Fed Hikes
snippet: A June 9 Money Metals Exchange analysis by Mike Maharrey argues the market is misreading gold's selloff: while the May CPI print (4.2% year-over-year) is being treated as unambiguously bearish by pushing nominal rate-hike odds above 70%, higher inflation simultaneously compresses real yields — the actual driver of gold valuations — creating a scenario where precious metals could recover regardless of whether the Fed hikes. The piece contends that gold's true valuation anchor is the real rate (nominal rate minus inflation), and that if inflation remains sticky and runs faster than any rate adjustment, real yields could fall even in a rate-hike environment, replicating the setup that powered gold's initial 2025-2026 bull leg.

headline: METALS FOCUS: GOLD BULL MARKET 'STILL HAS LEGS' — H2 2026 Recovery Expected as Structural Demand Pillars Remain Intact
snippet: Metals Focus's Gold Focus 2026 annual report, published via GoldSeek on June 8-9, 2026, maintains a bullish price forecast for H2 despite gold retreating from January's $5,600 highs, with the firm's analysts expecting the bull market to resume once current geopolitical uncertainty clears. The report's core thesis separates temporary paper-market selling (rate hike expectations, geopolitical ceasefire premium unwinding) from structural demand that remains intact: central bank accumulation, de-dollarisation by BRICS-aligned sovereigns, and a persistent U.S. fiscal deficit that has no near-term resolution — the same forces that drove gold from $2,000 to $5,600 in less than two years.

headline: RECORD EARNINGS, DECADE-LOW P/Es: GDX Top 25 Gold Miners Trading Below 20x Earnings Despite $2,900/oz Q2 Profit Forecast
snippet: A June 2026 Investing.com analysis finds that GDX's top 25 gold miners have fallen to their cheapest earnings multiples in at least a decade despite share prices near all-time highs, with the trailing P/E ratio declining below 20x as Q1 2026 — reported against a $4,900/oz average gold price — set sector-wide earnings records. If gold holds its current Q2 average following the CPI-driven selloff, major producers are still forecast to earn approximately $2,900 per ounce in Q2, representing 56% year-over-year unit earnings growth; the piece argues that investors correlating gold's paper-market weakness with miner fundamentals are conflating a sentiment discount with a fundamental deterioration that has not yet materialized in the income statement.
